related.title: 編譯器前端與中介表示
related.titleEn: Compiler front ends and intermediate representations
related.why: SSA、型別與控制流是共同基礎
related.whyEn: SSA, types and control flow are shared foundations
related.transfer: SSA、型別與控制流是共同基礎
related.transferEn: SSA, types and control flow are shared foundations
related.difference: 前端建立語義表示，JIT 還需執行時狀態復原
related.differenceEn: Frontends represent semantics; JIT must recover runtime state
practice: 由「JIT 與 AOT」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「前端建立語義表示，JIT 還需執行時狀態復原」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From jit and aot, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "Frontends represent semantics; JIT must recover runtime state", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.
